english translation text: My Maula, hear this plea: call us too to Karbala.

arabic text: ZAIRON MEIN MERA NAAM LIKHDO\nKARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text: Write my name among the visitors;\ncall us too to Karbala.

arabic text:
JO BHI ATA HAI DAR PE TUMHARE
NAAZ KARTE HAIN KHUD USPE TAARE
MAIN BHI KHADIM HOON MOLA TUMHARA
JEE RAHA HOON TUMHARE SAHARE
MERI UMEED KI LAAJ RAKHLO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text:
Whoever comes to your door is
envied even by the stars.
I too am your servant, Maula,
living only through your support.
Preserve the honour of my hope;
call us too to Karbala.

arabic text:
APKA DAR HAI JANNAT ZAMEEN PER
HUSN DEKHA NA AISA KAHEEN PER
TUM JO KEHDO TO AJAON URRR KAR
AUR REH JAON BAS MAIN WAHEEN PER
APNA ZAWWAR MUJHKO BANADO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO

MERI SANSON MEIN BHI KARBALA HAI
MERI BATON MEIN BHI KARBALA HAI
DIL KI DHARKAN MEIN ROZA TUMHARA
MERI ANKHON MEIN BHI KARBALA HAI
DIL YE BECHAIN HAI KITNA DEKHO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text:
Karbala lives within my breaths,
within my words and within my heartbeat.
Your shrine lives within my heart,
and Karbala within my eyes.
See how restless this heart is;
call us too to Karbala.

arabic text:
TEER KHAYA JAHAN BE ZUBAN NE
KHAI BARHI JAHAN NO JAWAN NE
JIS JAGA KAT KAY BAZOO GIRE THE
GHAM MANAYA JAHAN DO JAHAN NE
HUM WAHAN GHAM MANAIN RIZA DO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text:
Where the speechless infant received
the arrow, where the young
man received the spear, and
where the severed arms fell—
where both worlds mourned, grant
us permission to grieve there.

arabic text:
APKA SAR JAHAN PER KATA THA
MAIN WAHAN JAKE MATAM KARUNGA
JIS JAGA THE JALE SARE KHEME
JAL GAYA THA JAHAN WAHEEN KURTA
DUNGA PURSA WAHAN SYEDA KO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text:
Where your head was severed,
I will go and perform
matam. Where all the tents
burned and the garment itself
caught fire, I will offer
condolences to the Sayyida there.

arabic text:
LAB PE ZEESHAN KAY KARBALA HAI
HATH UTHAYE KAREEM E AZA HAI
APKE DAR PE HUM SATH AAAIN
YE TAMANNA HAI BAS YE DUA HAI
APNI KHIDMAT KA BAS YE SILA DO
KARBALA AB HUMEN BHI BULALO
english translation text:
Karbala remains upon Zeeshan's lips,
while Kareem-e-Aza raises his hands in prayer.
Our only longing and prayer is
to come together to your door.
Grant us this reward for our service;
call us too to Karbala.
